v55: italic sec-/tert- prefixes (display layer) + explainChip + docs

fMulerItalicSecTert applied at boxes, preview, explanations, rule panel (withN for (n-)). Raw engine/oracle/matching untouched. ROADMAP.md added.

v56: fork from v55 + selection-mode button (icon, entry, flag, gates)

Fork: mulermoc-nom-56.html + js/*-56.js + css/*-56.css + data_56.js (?v=56.0); index.html stays on v55; v55 files untouched.

Selection entry (phase 1A UI): MuLERIcons.selectAtoms; #selectAtomsBtn left of Edit; fToggleAtomSelect + MulerUserSelection.active + crosshair cursor; allowSelect master switch default on; dim without molecule; draftLocked block; hidden in Present. Capture + contents = phase 1B.

v56: 2D click-to-select atoms/bonds (phase 1B) + compacted-group pick

Add selectAtomsBtn (title bar, first) with pointer cursor, gated by Allow-selections checkbox; draft mode force-exits selection. Click handling: atoms via order maps, bonds via svgBondList ranges, implicit-C/skeletal via JSME vertex mapping with deterministic fallback; condensed CHn groups atoms; compacted labels select whole fragment. Translucent cyan overlay re-rendered on each repaint; Esc/empty-canvas clears; Present mode hides button. Includes parallel owner tweaks (init-3.spt picking/measurement off, selectAtomsBtn 20px icon + pointer cursor) and tools/muler-harness probes. index.html stays on v55.

v56: native-channel cyan selection + hover preview + pick accuracy

Selection look rework: paint through the native JSME background channel
instead of DOM halos (palette slot 2 -> #22d3ee, slots are 1-based;
boot-time merge wrapper, component-wins; resets for clears since JSME
ignores empty-string sets; Present pushes component-only; install
verified + self-healing retry; draft applet untouched).
Condensed hidden members paint-filtered via the compaction skip set
(anchor only paints); fill-restricted circle twin of the near-text
cleanup.
Pick accuracy: order maps exclude hidden atoms; bond groups adjust for
compaction-deleted lines (per-render removed-bond record); near-text
collector skips the bg (index 0); anchors prefer text centers;
skeletal sp-C labels hidden not deleted + marker-skipped; skeletal
heteroatoms resolve geometrically via bond-endpoint proximity.
Hover preview: rAF-throttled mousemove reuses the click pick path,
stroke-only cyan ring overlay (DOM-only, never the applet channel),
per-render geometry cache, armed-mode only (SW 30, bond 110, 0.55 op).
Probe-final asserts cyan fill + hover ring. Docs updated.
Owner tweaks kept as-is (selectAtomsBtn icon, crosshair cursor,
init-3.spt picking off). index.html stays on v55.

v56: quiz 1C — selection, order, direction, multi-chain + hover

2D atom/bond click-to-select (atoms toggle on plain click, JSmol-style;
shift identical; kinds exclusive; Esc/empty-canvas clears), hover preview
(rAF-throttled DOM ring, per-render geometry cache), native-channel cyan
paint with reset-first exactness, pick accuracy (order maps, compaction-aware
bond groups, bg protection, skeletal hetero anchors, joint adoption for
multi-line C-side ends).
Quiz: box click while armed sets a target (main chain first); live
set-compare with exact/subset/wrong/disjoint verdicts; pick-order badges;
walk must be bonded (order verdict); C1-first direction enforced
(direction verdict); pool-wide multi-chain acceptance with auto-adopt
(stepper path, adopted-only in data mode); either direction accepted for
symmetric chains (orienter-indifference oracle). Probe-quiz added.
Owner live-tested selection + hover; formal node --check + harness matrix
pending on the browser machine. index.html stays on v55.

v56: main-chain compacted-carbon picks, paint hardening, skeletal vertex joints

Main-chain purpose (compCarbonsCount target): a carbon-anchored compact
label resolves to its anchor carbon only, whole-label/backplate hit area
included; free selection keeps the whole fragment; N/S anchors never
convert. Arming normalizes an existing carbon fragment; paint restores the
backplate, hides the native ellipse and draws a glyph-sized path behind the
carbon glyph; badge and hover follow that glyph.

Review hardening: the enlarged hit area is main-chain-only (free selection
keeps the glyph run), the paint is idempotent via a backplate marker
(component green still wins, Present hidden), the C-only path and ellipse
hide survive a missing backplate, and the ellipse hide is ownership-guarded
by the label backing rect.

Skeletal joints: offset ends of multi-line bonds merge into their true joint
before vertex-to-atom assignment, so aldehyde carbonyl carbons pick the
carbon instead of the oxygen (propanal/butanal/pentanal/propynal) and
ethanal's joint/methyl end resolve correctly; ketones, acids, esters and
methanal keep their assignments.

Probes: probe-compact-main (free vs main, C-only paint, methanal, free
backplate edge, clear restore), probe-skel-joints (16 molecules, joint
invariants). Verified: full harness matrix green, node --check and
git diff --check clean. index.html stays on v55.

v56: final-only quiz verdicts, selection-mode viewer ownership, explain-all fix

Quiz verdicts: partial picks, outside-chain atoms and no-overlap stay silent;
only exact, and direction/order once the picked set is complete, are shown.

Selection mode owns the viewer: fExplainNameComp early-returns while select
mode is armed (one-shot __mulerQuizReward for the exact reward), so 2D-style
switches never paint the name-component highlight. A main-chain quiz target
survives a style switch (molecule change still disarms) and the prompt is
re-asserted; picked atoms are dropped with the old geometry.

Explain-all overview: the quiet build may generate explanation text again
(no more nested explainTable in every explainCell), the scrape rejects its
own markup, closing restores the quiz prompt/clears the panel, and arming or
an exact verdict repaints the cached table.

Selection fill detection derives hex + rgb forms from MULER_SELECT_CYAN
(#6ddcbe in the working tree) with legacy cyan kept; the compaction circle
cleanup shares the helper, and the sequence badge follows the palette.

Probes: probe-quiz final-only assertions, probe-mode-quiz, probe-explain-all,
probe-compact-main derives the selection color instead of hardcoding cyan.
Verified: full harness matrix green; node --check + git diff --check clean.
index.html stays on v55.
v56: core chemistry review fixes + quiz live hints + sticky re-arm + harness hardening

v56: bond-locant FG match gate, branch wording/numbering, ether alkoxy quizzes, single-bond verdicts

- Locant boxes gate FG paint/quiz on principal position atoms
  (fMulerFGPositionAtoms): triple-bond locant in an FG-position box
  (methyl_3_pentyn_4_ol_2 comp4) and double-bond locant alpha to a
  2-keto (en-yne dione comp4) fall through to bond handling in both
  classic and quiz paths.
- Branch prompts split: name boxes use the short substituent strings,
  locant boxes keep the 'indicated position' wording (pick + exact).
- Numbering aid on locants only (branch aid gated to locant targets);
  carbon-count box keeps its numbering; name/class boxes numberless.
- Systematic ether alkoxy boxes arm branch quizzes (O + alkoxy chain):
  2-ethoxypropane name direct, locant via chain-first.
- Single-bond (avan) quizzes use single-bond verdict strings, never
  'multiple bond'.
- Probes: new bond cases (FG-position triple locant, alpha-keto
  double locant, single-bond wording), ether alkoxy name/locant
  flows; README updated.

Static verification only (balanced braces, lang-key coverage, wiring
present); browser probe run still pending (no node/browser here).

index to v56; css veryLightEarth panel

+### Chemistry review fixes (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13)

+
+### Selection-mode button (v56 working tree, 2026-11-12)
+- New `MuLERIcons.selectAtoms` (from `imgs/mouse-click-svgrepo-com.svg`; shared registry, additive — no v55 impact). `#selectAtomsBtn` first in the title bar (`molview-56.js`), `window.MulerUserSelection.active` flag (`fToggleAtomSelect`), pointer cursor on `#jsmeNomeclatureSVG.selecting` (owner choice).

Precedence is component-wins (single merge-order switch); empty selection passes args through byte-identical. Probe extended with the free-mode backplate edge, clear/marker restore and methanal.
+- Skeletal vertex joints (v56 working tree, 2026-11-13): offset ends of multi-line bonds (parallel-line spacing, ~60 SVG units) are now merged into their true joint in `fMulerSelectVertices` before the vertex→atom assignment, so the joint's atom is resolved topologically instead of by the greedy free-atom rule. Fixes skeletal aldehydes (only one drawn single bond at the carbonyl carbon, so the old joint-adoption pass — which requires a multi-bond target — never fired): clicking the carbonyl carbon selected the oxygen in propanal/butanal/pentanal/propynal, while ethanal mapped the true joint to the methyl carbon and left the methyl end unresolved.  Forked from v54 (`mulermoc-nom-55.html` + `js/*-55.js` + `css/*-55.css`, `?v=55.0`). Draft 3D is now 3-tier: PubChem SDF → JSmol remote `load $SMILES` (`fMolDraftRemote3DFromJSmol`: applet proxy-routed, works CDN + local, no page-side fetch so no CORS wall; scriptWait + SDF read-back, validated) → local 2D-MOL + UFF minimize in JSmol (offline, `fMolDraftLocal3DFromMol`: inline `load data` + `add hydrogens` + blocking `minimize steps 500` via scriptWait — fire-and-forget raced read-back with pre-minimize coords — then SDF extracted back via `molFile`/`show MOL`, validated by `fMolDraftValidSDF3D` heavy-count + non-flat-z). Orchestrated by `fMolDraftFetchSDF3DTiered` with epoch/submitId guards; preview shows source-labeled 3D row (local flagged provisional), fetching note, all-miss 2D-only note. Accept ungated on any tier success (was PubChem-3D-only); provenance persisted as `sdf3DSource` (rec + update path + history + save-file headers). SDF read-back is `write MOL` alone (translate-test proved it the sole live-model serializer: `molFile` returns an unparseable layout, `fileContents` is a stale dump), logging length + heavy count + heavy-only z-spread + verdict. The V2000 parser now reads z (flat-2D text correctly fails the non-flat check, spread over heavies only so H-noise can't fake 3D). The planar-saddle trap (exactly-flat input freezes MMFF: zero heavy displacement) plus E=46000+ overlap divergence are broken by a pure-JS 2D untangle (spreads non-bonded heavy overlaps) + z-jiggle (±0.3 Å), both self-verifying, with tier-3 acceptance requiring heavy displacement vs the prepared input (`fMolDraftMovedEnough`, mean ≥ 0.05 Å) plus plain-`minimize` retry; `zap`-first loads with `calculate hydrogens`, live load-verify (heavy count + matches-loaded ≈ 0), always-show-flat-3D on total miss, and a manual Minimize-3D fallback button in the preview: pressing it runs the pipeline, then an OK-only dialog asks to save the 3D conformation once optimization completes — OK stores best-effort (`jsmol-min` when validated, `jsmol-unminimized` live model otherwise) and unlocks Accept (ESC/backdrop = back out, stay locked). Minimize is fire-and-forget (follow-up scripts interrupt the in-flight run — console-proven) with a single delayed read-back, explicit MMFF-then-UFF force fields, and iterative re-minimize from the live model on repeat presses (movement judged vs the pre-fire snapshot, no convergence requirement — partial descent counts). `?v=55.0` unchanged across all v55 commits — hard-reload (Ctrl+Shift+R) after pulling. +

+# muler-harness (headless verification)
+
+Playwright + installed Chrome probes for the MuLERMoC v56 working tree.
+Run from the repo root. Requires node + Playwright (`npm i playwright-core`
+once, anywhere on NODE_PATH or in this dir) and a Chrome binary.
+
+Assumptions (edit the constant at the top of each probe if yours differ):
+- repo served at `http://localhost:8901` via `server.js` below
+  (override via `MULER_BASE`, e.g. `MULER_BASE=http://localhost:8902`);
+- Chrome at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`
+  (override via `MULER_CHROME`; if the path does not exist the probe lets
+  Playwright resolve the browser on its own).
+- Cold-load waits use `waitForFunction` on the JSME SVG + selection API
+  (30 s timeout) + short settle, not fixed 14 s sleeps.
+
+Scripts are read-only against the app; screenshots land in the current
+working directory.
+
+- `server.js [port]` — minimal static file server for the repo root
+  (no-cache, correct MIME incl. `.sdf`). Start first, in the background:
+  `node tools/muler-harness/server.js 8901`
+- `probe-final.js` — end-to-end smoke: cold load, atom pick, hover preview,
+  empty-canvas clear, and mode-switch invalidation. Prints state JSON.
+- `probe-pick7.js <mol> <condensed|expanded|skeletal> "atom,N [s]" ...`
+  — generic pick tester: `atom,3` clicks the 3rd text anchor (0-based),
+  `bond,2` clicks the middle of bond index 2, trailing `s` = shift-click,
+  `empty` = click empty canvas. Prints resulting selection after each step.
+- `probe-shift.js` — shift-accumulate check on ethane (CTM-derived 2nd pick, asserts accumulation).
+- `probe-quiz.js` — main-chain quiz: checks bond hover/click suppression without losing atom picks in condensed, expanded and skeletal modes, plus normal bond behavior outside the quiz; checks live numberless hints, exact success, reverse direction and scrambled order; screenshot `quiz-green.png`.
+- `probe-fg-quiz.js` — FG suffix quiz (set-only, numberless, atoms-only): ethanol O pick exacts with no badges, carbon-first gives a numberless non-hetero/non-gap hint, hydrocarbon -ιο never arms, bond clicks are ignored while armed, condensed COOH label click takes the heavy fragment, and expanded ethanal accepts its explicit aldehyde H.
+- `probe-loc-quiz.js` — locant-box quiz (shared FG task, purpose "loc", chain-first prerequisite): EN pentanone_2/comp4 and GR pentanone_2/comp0 redirect to chain, then auto-arm loc with numbering aid and a cleared chain verdict; full picks exact; dione comp7 completes the same cycle.
+- `probe-bond-quiz.js` — bond quiz (number locants redirect to chain; type boxes arm directly): butene_1 comp6 double-bond atoms exact, bond-line pick exacts alone, bonds hover in quiz; butyne_2 comp4 locant redirects, solves, auto-arms triple and exacts on a bond click; methyl_3_pentyn_4_ol_2 comp4 triple locant in an FG-position box (unarmed names the triple bond, never hydroxyl; armed redirects, auto-arms bond); ethyl_3_methyl_4_octen_3_yn_5_dione_2_7 comp4 double locant alpha to a 2-keto (same bond-not-FG contract); butadiene_1_3 reversed 4-atom set; ethane "αν" all-singles exact with single-bond wording (never "multiple bond"); wrong picks give bond-flavored numberless hints.
+- `probe-branch-quiz.js` — branch quiz (locants redirect to chain; name boxes arm directly; name = short prompt, locant = long "indicated position" prompt; numbering aid on locants only): hydrocarbon and ester-alkyl behavior; systematic ether alkoxy boxes arm O + alkoxy chain (2-ethoxypropane name direct, locant via chain); all six branch boxes of ethyl_4_isopropyl_3_methyl_2_hexanal in traditional and systematic naming with independently checked targets and rewards; Greek condensed selection, wrong picks, representation and active-chain changes; acid, ketone, alcohol, ester and ether branches; FG, bond and alkoxy precedence, ambiguous-piece fallback, and molecule switching.
+- `probe-mode-quiz.js` — selection-mode 2D-style switches: an armed quiz must keep the viewer clean (0 green shapes), keep the target/prompt/comp5 selection and drop the picked atoms; picking the chain in the new style then shows the success line + green; a post-exact switch stays clean; with select mode off the classic component highlight still paints and survives a switch.
+- `probe-explain-all.js` — explain-all overview under selection mode: open/close cycles build exactly one table with per-component cells (no nested tables, no green paint), close restores the quiz prompt (or clears the panel), a style switch rebuilds cleanly with the quiz target kept, and an exact verdict keeps the table while painting green.
+- `probe-frag2.js` — compacted-label (e.g. COOH) whole-fragment pick (free selection):
+  CTM-derived center click, asserts whole-fragment on first click and
+  toggle-clear on re-click; hard-fail on miss or page error.
+- `probe-coverage56.js` — gap coverage: multiple H picks on one carbon in expanded mode (free picks stay atomic; armed-quiz H clicks redirect to the parent carbon with toggle symmetry and H-completed chains still exact), in-page
+  molecule-switch sticky re-arm (contents cleared, stays armed, quiz re-armed + prompt restored when comp5 sticks; condensed carbon-only anchor pick on the post-switch molecule),
+  `allowSelect` gating (hide entry when off, uncheck-while-active exits),
+  Present block (toggle no-op + CSS hides the entry). Hard-fail.
+- `probe-compact-main.js` — main-chain versus free compacted-label semantics: COOH/HCOOH/CN resolve to the anchor carbon under a main-chain target, NO2 stays a fragment, free selection stays a fragment; checks C-only paint, hover box, badge, exact reward, the free-mode backplate edge, clear/marker restore and methanal (no highlight geometry).
+- `probe-skel-joints.js` — skeletal vertex→atom assignment: for 16 molecules across aldehydes, ketones, acids, ester, alkene, alkyne, nitrile and nitro, asserts every vertex pick is an endpoint of all its incident bonds, no offset multi-line end is left unmerged, and every carbonyl carbon's incident-bond line endpoints (the old "click the carbon, get the oxygen" spot) select the carbon. Guards the C=O offset-end merge in `fMulerSelectVertices`.
+- `audit.js <port> <query|- > <width> <out>` — tooltip clip audit:
+  measures every `[data-tooltip]` bubble against overflow ancestors and the
+  viewport; prints TOTAL / SPILL count + offending entries.
+
+Conventions: selection state lives in `window.MulerUserSelection`;
+all pick/render functions fail closed (return null / no-op on any gap).
